request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo with backing choir, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, piano, cymbals, solemn and determined mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
All discipline seems painful
Rather than pleasant at the time
But later it yields a harvest
Of righteousness and peace for us

[Chorus]
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness without which no one will see the Lord
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness to see the face of God

[Verse]
Therefore strengthen your drooping hands
And your weak knees on the ground
Make straight paths for your feet
So that what is lame may be healed

[Chorus]
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness without which no one will see the Lord
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness to see the face of God

[Bridge]
See to it no one falls short
Of the grace of God in our lives
No bitter root grows up
To cause trouble and defile many

[Verse]
No one is sexually immoral
Or godless like Esau did
Who sold his birthright
For a single meal of food

[Chorus]
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness without which no one will see the Lord
Pursue peace with everyone
And holiness to see the face of God

[Outro]
He found no chance to repent
Though he sought it with tears
